title: What If the Power Grid Failed for a Whole Week?

scenes.text: What if the power grid failed for a whole week? The first hours are not the worst part.
Phone and TV signals stop at once, and factories go quiet. Within hours, batteries run flat.
Emergency power supplies run out of fuel in a few hours, and intensive care and dialysis units struggle to continue.
Few gas stations have backup power for their pumps, so refueling stops for the public and for first responders.
Water plants with limited backup power can lose pressure. Refrigerated medicines spoil without electricity.
After a few days, a German study found the supply of vital goods to the population collapses.

description:
What if the power grid failed for a whole week?
Researchers found phones, hospitals, fuel and water all depend on electricity, and supplies collapse after a few days.
What should we run through next?
